title: Philippine Remittance AML
thesis: Snowflake turns daily activity at the agent outlets of a fictional Philippine remittance company into alert-precision KPIs, 7-day suspicious-activity risk scores, split-transfer anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Alert precision, alerts raised, STRs drafted and transfer volume in PHP for 40 agent outlets across 5 Philippine cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to outlet-day rows.
The detection-rule chart shows which rules produce confirmed suspicious activity and which mostly produce false positives, such as holiday volume surges.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of AML KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which outlets should investigators look at first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each outlet's probability of confirmed suspicious activity in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags split-transfer share outliers per outlet, and the forecast projects network-wide alert volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Outlet review compliance, agent document coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Review compliance against confirmed alerts by outlet shows where weak reviews and suspicious activity move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions for the Chief Compliance Officer from the KPI, outlet, detection-rule and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a suspicious transfer lands right now?

talking_points: Live transfer events land in RAW.LIVE_TRANSFERS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALERT events with an SOP hint and the outlet's current risk band, then emails the investigator.
tabs.call_out: From transfer to case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic investigation SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
